limits.name: Maximum Cell Voltage
limits.description: Exceeding this cell voltage risks lithium plating and thermal runaway.

limits.name: Minimum Cell Voltage
limits.description: Dropping below this voltage triggers copper dissolution and internal short-circuits.

limits.name: Maximum State of Charge
limits.description: High SoC accelerates capacity degradation due to elevated anodic potential.

limits.name: Minimum State of Charge
limits.description: Low SoC values limit active reserve capacity and increase depth-of-discharge stress.
